palisec_deployed_contracts_note: PALISEC deploys no contracts of its own. It uses the canonical Safe and ERC-4337 deployments below, which were already on this chain; their deployment transactions were made by third parties and are not recorded here. Each customer's smart account is a Safe proxy created by the customer's own wallet from the console.
